nodes.text: HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) is a respiratory virus causing cold-like symptoms, particularly severe in children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. It spreads through respiratory droplets and close contact, leading to infections ranging from mild colds to pneumonia. https://t.co/mJmtll8CuI
